The platform could not resolve this productRef (often a wrong/missing product or API base URL mismatch). A 400 "Invalid identifier" here means the product did not resolve — not that the DCR body was malformed. Run `npx solvapay doctor` or check SOLVAPAY_PRODUCT_REF / SOLVAPAY_API_BASE_URL.
